extra_vocab.en: in equal parts or in the same way everywhere
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於分配工作、費用、資源和產品說明，表示分得很平均或塗得很均勻。也可形容兩隊實力相當。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: evenly 常用被動句型：be evenly divided／distributed／spread，也可放在動詞後，如 divide the cost evenly。

example.en: Please divide the tickets evenly among all departments.
example.zh: 請把票平均分給所有部門。

example.en: The new funds were evenly distributed across all branches.
example.zh: 新的資金被平均分配到所有分店。

example.en: Spread the paint evenly on the wall with a roller.
example.zh: 用滾筒把油漆均勻塗在牆上。

examples.en: Cook the rice slowly so it heats evenly.
examples.zh: 慢慢煮飯，讓它受熱均勻。

examples.en: The two teams were evenly matched, so the game was close.
examples.zh: 兩隊實力相當，所以比賽很膠著。

examples.en: The cost will be shared evenly between the two companies.
examples.zh: 費用會由兩家公司平均分攤。

confusable.diff: even 當副詞是「甚至」，也可當形容詞「平的、偶數的」；evenly 是「均勻地、平均地」。
confusable.usage: even 是副詞時放在要強調的字前面，如 even the manager；evenly 修飾動詞，說明分配的方式。

example.en: Even the manager was surprised by the sales results.
example.zh: 連經理都對銷售結果感到驚訝。

similar.diff: equally 強調程度或機會相同；evenly 強調分得平均、分布均勻。

example.en: All members have equally important roles in this project.
example.zh: 所有成員在這個專案中都扮演同樣重要的角色。

similar.diff: fairly 強調公平、不偏心；evenly 強調數量或分布均等。

example.en: The manager treats every employee fairly.
example.zh: 經理公平地對待每一位員工。

example.en: Each partner receives an equal share of the profit.
example.zh: 每位合夥人都得到相等的利潤份額。

example.en: The price is fair for this quality.
example.zh: 以這個品質來說，價格很公平。

example.en: We try to keep a balance between work and rest.
example.zh: 我們努力在工作與休息之間取得平衡。

example.en: Each person pays a share of the cost.
example.zh: 每個人分攤一部分費用。

derived.link: 最基礎的字；evenly = even + -ly，變成副詞，像 slowly、clearly
un-（不）+ even，不平均的，像 unhappy、unable

extra_vocab.en: to officially join a course, school, or program
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於學校、課程、培訓和員工福利方案，表示正式報名或加入。美式拼法是 enroll，英式拼法是 enrol。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: enroll 後面接 in + 課程、學校或方案；也常用被動 be enrolled in。美式拼法 enroll，英式拼法 enrol。

example.en: A new student enrolls at our school every week.
example.zh: 每週都有一位新學生到我們學校註冊。

example.en: Mr. Lee enrolled in the evening class to improve his English.
example.zh: 李先生報名了夜間班來加強他的英文。

example.en: She is enrolling her son in a summer camp.
example.zh: 她正在替兒子報名暑期營隊。

example.en: Ms. Park wants to enroll in a night course on accounting.
example.zh: 朴小姐想報名一門會計的夜間課程。

example.en: Staff may enroll in the language program for free.
example.zh: 員工可以免費報名語言課程。

example.en: Please enroll as a member to receive a ten percent discount.
example.zh: 請登記成為會員，即可享有九折優惠。

examples.en: Parents can enroll their children online before the end of August.
examples.zh: 家長可以在八月底前線上替孩子報名。

examples.en: You can enroll in the company health plan until next Friday.
examples.zh: 你可以在下週五前加入公司的健康保險方案。

examples.en: All new employees must enroll for the safety training this month.
examples.zh: 所有新進員工這個月都必須報名安全訓練。

confusable.diff: enlist 是「入伍」或「爭取…的協助」；enroll 是「註冊、報名」，拼法相近。

example.en: We will enlist local volunteers to help at the event.
example.zh: 我們會爭取當地志工來協助這場活動。

similar.diff: register 範圍更廣，可指登記帳號、報到或註冊；enroll 多用於學校、課程和方案。

example.en: Please register at the front desk when you arrive.
example.zh: 到達時請在櫃檯登記。

similar.diff: sign up 是口語說法，語氣輕鬆，後面常接 for。

example.en: Many staff members signed up for the yoga class.
example.zh: 許多員工報名了瑜珈課。

example.en: The course starts on the first Monday of March.
example.zh: 這門課在三月的第一個星期一開始。

example.en: This training program lasts for six weeks.
example.zh: 這個培訓計畫為期六週。

example.en: Each student receives a free textbook.
example.zh: 每位學生都會拿到一本免費教科書。

example.en: The tuition includes all books and materials.
example.zh: 學費包含所有書籍和教材。

senses.en: to officially join a school or course

example.en: Applicants must enroll before the first day of class.
example.zh: 申請者必須在開課第一天之前完成註冊。

senses.en: to join a plan or program
senses.distinguish: 後面接 plan、insurance、program 時，指加入方案。

example.en: New employees can enroll in the retirement plan after three months.
example.zh: 新進員工三個月後可以加入退休計畫。

extra_vocab.en: a person who travels to new places to learn about them
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於旅遊、博物館和歷史相關的文章，指去未知地方探險的人。電腦用語中也有 File Explorer 這個軟體名稱。

example.en: Many explorers traveled by ship to reach new lands.
example.zh: 許多探險家搭船到達新的土地。

example.en: A famous explorer will give a talk at the museum tonight.
example.zh: 一位著名的探險家今晚將在博物館演講。

example.en: The polar explorer showed photos from his trip to Antarctica.
example.zh: 這位極地探險家展示了他去南極旅行的照片。

example.en: Early explorers used the stars to find their way at sea.
example.zh: 早期的探險家靠星星在海上找路。

examples.en: Our guide is a former explorer who knows the mountains well.
examples.zh: 我們的導遊是一位前探險家，非常了解這些山。

examples.en: Open File Explorer to find the report you saved yesterday.
examples.zh: 打開檔案總管，找出你昨天儲存的報告。

examples.en: The explorer wrote a book about his trip across the desert.
examples.zh: 這位探險家寫了一本關於他橫越沙漠旅程的書。

confusable.diff: exporter 是出口商；explorer 是探險家，兩個字拼法相近。

example.en: The exporter ships coffee beans to twelve countries.
example.zh: 這家出口商把咖啡豆運到十二個國家。

similar.diff: adventurer 是愛冒險的人，不一定要去未知的地方；explorer 強調探索新地方。

example.en: The young adventurer wrote about her trip on her blog.
example.zh: 這位年輕的冒險者在部落格上寫了她的旅行。

example.en: The expedition lasted for three months.
example.zh: 這次遠征持續了三個月。

example.en: The journey to the island takes two hours.
example.zh: 到那座島的旅程需要兩個小時。

example.en: Please check the map before you leave.
example.zh: 出發前請先看一下地圖。

example.en: The guide explained the history of the old town.
example.zh: 導遊說明了這座古城的歷史。

derived.link: 最基礎的字；explorer = explore + -r，探索的人，像 writer、driver
explore 去 e 加 -ation，變成名詞，像 decorate → decoration

senses.en: a person who travels to new places to learn about them

example.en: The explorer spent two years mapping the river.
example.zh: 這位探險家花了兩年繪製這條河的地圖。

senses.en: a computer tool for looking at files or web pages
senses.distinguish: 出現 File Explorer、open、folder 等電腦詞彙時，指軟體。

example.en: Use the explorer on the left to open the project folder.
example.zh: 使用左邊的檔案總管來打開專案資料夾。

extra_vocab.en: special skill or knowledge in one area
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於徵才、顧問和專案說明，指某人在特定領域的專業能力。語氣正面、正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: expertise 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 an；常用 expertise in／on + 領域。

example.en: He has the technical expertise to fix the network problem.
example.zh: 他有技術專長，可以解決網路問題。

example.en: She has great expertise in international trade and shipping.
example.zh: 她在國際貿易和運輸方面很有專長。

example.en: Customer service is my main area of expertise.
example.zh: 客戶服務是我主要的專業領域。

examples.en: We need someone with real expertise to lead the new project.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位真正有專業能力的人來帶領新專案。

examples.en: The company hired a consultant for her legal expertise.
examples.zh: 公司因為這位顧問的法律專長而聘請了她。

examples.en: Your expertise will be very helpful in the next meeting.
examples.zh: 你的專業知識對下一場會議會很有幫助。

confusable.diff: expert 是「專家」這個人；expertise 是專家具備的專業知識或能力。
confusable.usage: expert 是可數名詞（人），expertise 是不可數名詞（能力）。

example.en: We asked an expert to check the electrical system.
example.zh: 我們請了一位專家檢查電力系統。

similar.diff: knowledge 是一般的知識；expertise 強調在某個領域很深入的專業能力。

example.en: She has good knowledge of the local market.
example.zh: 她對當地市場很了解。

similar.diff: skill 是可以練習的技能；expertise 是長期累積的專業知識與技能。

example.en: Good writing is an important skill for this job.
example.zh: 寫作能力是這份工作的重要技能。

example.en: Computer skills are required for this job.
example.zh: 這份工作需要電腦技能。

example.en: He shared his knowledge with the new staff.
example.zh: 他和新進員工分享了他的知識。

example.en: She has ten years of experience in banking.
example.zh: 她有十年的銀行業經驗。

example.en: He has the ability to solve problems quickly.
example.zh: 他有快速解決問題的能力。

derived.link: 最基礎的字；expertise 是專家具備的能力

extra_vocab.en: permission not to follow a rule or pay something
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於稅務、法規和入學規定，指可以不必遵守規定或不必繳費的許可。語氣正式，常見於公告和合約。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: exemption 後面常接 from + 規定或費用；動詞是 exempt A from B（使 A 免除 B）。

example.en: Several exemptions are listed in the new tax guide.
example.zh: 新的稅務指南列出了幾項豁免。

example.en: This tax exemption applies only to small companies.
example.zh: 這項免稅只適用於小型公司。

example.en: Staff over sixty have an exemption from the night shift.
example.zh: 六十歲以上的員工可免值夜班。

example.en: You must apply for an exemption before the end of May.
example.zh: 你必須在五月底前申請豁免。

example.en: The city will grant an exemption to older buildings.
example.zh: 市政府會批准老建築豁免。

examples.en: Small businesses may qualify for an exemption this year.
examples.zh: 小型企業今年可能符合豁免資格。

examples.en: The new rule gives an exemption to medical equipment.
examples.zh: 新規定給予醫療設備豁免。

examples.en: The rule has one exemption for emergency vehicles.
examples.zh: 這項規定對緊急車輛有一項例外豁免。

confusable.diff: exception 是「例外」，不符合一般情況的事；exemption 是「免除」，被正式允許不必遵守或繳費。

example.en: We make no exception to the payment deadline.
example.zh: 對於付款期限，我們不做任何例外。

similar.diff: waiver 是放棄某項權利或要求的文件；exemption 是被免除義務的許可。

example.en: Please sign the waiver before you join the tour.
example.zh: 參加行程前請簽署免責聲明。

example.en: The tax is included in the final price.
example.zh: 稅金已包含在最後的價格裡。

example.en: Our return policy is clearly shown in the store.
example.zh: 我們的退貨規定清楚張貼在店裡。

example.en: You need permission to enter the lab.
example.zh: 進入實驗室需要許可。

example.en: A college degree is a basic requirement.
example.zh: 大學學歷是基本要求。

derived.link: 最基礎的字；exemption = exempt + -ion，變成名詞，像 act → action

extra_vocab.en: a tool that you use to stop a fire
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於安全公告、辦公大樓和工廠情境，幾乎都以 fire extinguisher 出現。常搭配 check、use、inspect。

example.en: Extinguishers must be placed where everyone can reach them quickly.
example.zh: 滅火器必須放在大家都能很快拿到的地方。

example.en: Every kitchen must have a fire extinguisher by law.
example.zh: 依法每間廚房都必須有一個滅火器。

example.en: Do not use an extinguisher on an electrical fire without training.
example.zh: 沒有受過訓練，請勿對電器火災使用滅火器。

example.en: Check the extinguisher date label every six months.
example.zh: 每六個月檢查一次滅火器的日期標籤。

examples.en: The extinguisher is on the wall next to the kitchen door.
examples.zh: 滅火器掛在廚房門旁邊的牆上。

examples.en: Safety staff check every extinguisher once a month.
examples.zh: 安全人員每個月檢查每一個滅火器。

examples.en: Please learn how to use the extinguisher before an emergency happens.
examples.zh: 請在緊急狀況發生前學會怎麼使用滅火器。

confusable.diff: distinguish 是「區分、分辨」，字尾和 extinguish 很像；extinguish 是「撲滅」。

example.en: Can you distinguish the new model from the old one?
example.zh: 你分得出新款和舊款的差別嗎？

example.en: A small fire started in the storage room.
example.zh: 儲藏室裡發生了小火災。

example.en: The fire alarm rang during the meeting.
example.zh: 會議期間火災警報響了。

example.en: Call this number in an emergency.
example.zh: 發生緊急情況時，請撥打這個號碼。

example.en: The nearest exit is at the end of the hall.
example.zh: 最近的出口在走廊盡頭。

derived.link: 最基礎的字；extinguisher = extinguish + -er，用來滅火的工具，像 printer、computer

extra_vocab.zh: 主菜（美式）；前菜（英式、法式）
extra_vocab.en: the main dish of a meal
extra_vocab.note: 多益餐廳和宴會情境很常見。美式英語指主菜，英式或法式用法則指前菜，多益多半考美式的「主菜」。

example.en: All entrées are served with rice or a fresh salad.
example.zh: 所有主菜都附白飯或新鮮沙拉。

example.en: You may choose an entrée from the list on page two.
example.zh: 你可以從第二頁的清單中選一道主菜。

example.en: We offer a vegetarian entrée at every banquet.
example.zh: 每場宴會我們都提供素食主菜。

example.en: Every entrée comes with soup and a small salad.
example.zh: 每道主菜都附湯和一份小沙拉。

examples.en: For my entrée, I would like the grilled chicken, please.
examples.zh: 我的主菜想點烤雞，謝謝。

examples.en: The chef recommends the fish entrée on tonight's menu.
examples.zh: 主廚推薦今晚菜單上的魚類主菜。

examples.en: Guests may choose beef or fish for the dinner entrée.
examples.zh: 賓客的晚餐主菜可以選牛肉或魚。

confusable.diff: entry 是「進入、入口、參賽作品或登錄的項目」；entrée 是餐廳的主菜，兩字拼法與發音都相近。

example.en: The entry to the restaurant is on the north side.
example.zh: 餐廳的入口在北側。

similar.diff: main course 是通用的「主菜」說法，美英都懂；entrée 在美國才表示主菜。

example.en: The main course will be served at seven o'clock.
example.zh: 主菜會在七點上桌。

example.en: We ordered an appetizer to share.
example.zh: 我們點了一份開胃菜一起吃。

example.en: Dessert is included in the set menu.
example.zh: 甜點包含在套餐裡。

example.en: The menu changes with the season.
example.zh: 菜單會隨季節更換。

example.en: I made a reservation for six people.
example.zh: 我訂了六個人的位子。

senses.en: the main dish of a meal

example.en: The entrée at the company dinner was grilled salmon.
example.zh: 公司晚宴的主菜是烤鮭魚。

senses.en: a small dish served before the main dish
senses.distinguish: 在英國或法國餐廳的菜單上，entrée 排在主菜之前。

example.en: In France, an entrée is served before the main course.
example.zh: 在法國，前菜會在主菜之前上桌。

extra_vocab.en: the office of an ambassador in a foreign country
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於出差、簽證、護照和國際活動情境，指一個國家在他國首都設立的外交辦公室。

example.en: Several embassies are located in this quiet part of the city.
example.zh: 有好幾間大使館位於城裡這個安靜的區域。

example.en: Contact the embassy right away if you lose your passport abroad.
example.zh: 如果你在國外弄丟護照，請立刻聯絡大使館。

example.en: Embassy staff will help visitors who need urgent support.
example.zh: 大使館人員會協助需要緊急支援的旅客。

example.en: You must apply at the embassy for a long-term visa.
example.zh: 你必須在大使館申請長期簽證。

examples.en: Please bring your passport to the embassy on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 請星期一早上帶護照到大使館。

examples.en: The embassy is only ten minutes from our hotel by taxi.
examples.zh: 大使館離我們的飯店搭計程車只要十分鐘。

examples.en: The embassy will be closed on the national holiday next week.
examples.zh: 大使館下週國定假日會休館。

confusable.diff: consulate 是領事館，位於大城市，辦理簽證和協助僑民；embassy 是大使館，設在首都，代表整個國家。

example.en: The consulate in Chicago issues visas for business travelers.
example.zh: 芝加哥的領事館為商務旅客核發簽證。

example.en: The ambassador will attend the opening event.
example.zh: 大使會出席開幕活動。

example.en: You need a visa to stay for more than ninety days.
example.zh: 停留超過九十天需要簽證。

example.en: Please show your passport at the counter.
example.zh: 請在櫃檯出示你的護照。

example.en: We have several foreign clients in Asia.
example.zh: 我們在亞洲有幾位外國客戶。
